task_completion.description: Agent navigated to the EPA TRI program website or TRI Explorer tools.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows an epa.gov URL and the page content displays TRI search tools or factsheets.

task_completion.description: A Firefox bookmark folder named 'Community Health Research' was created with at least 4 EPA pages.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox bookmarks menu or sidebar shows a folder named 'Community Health Research' containing 4 or more bookmarks to EPA domains.

task_completion.description: An official TRI data file (CSV, Excel, or PDF) was downloaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox download manager or a file explorer window shows a TRI-related file (e.g., .csv, .xlsx, .pdf) larger than 10KB.

task_completion.description: Agent identified specific TRI data for Harris County, Texas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent viewing a TRI factsheet or report specifically for Harris County, TX, displaying facility counts or chemical release totals.

task_completion.description: Agent identified specific TRI data for St. James Parish, Louisiana.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent viewing a TRI factsheet or report specifically for St. James Parish, LA, displaying facility counts or chemical release totals.

task_completion.description: A summary report was created at ~/Documents/tri_community_report.txt with the required sections and data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows the file at the correct path containing sections for both locations with chemicals, facilities, and quantitative data.

integrity.description: The agent used the browser GUI to find information rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active mouse cursor movement and clicking on EPA website elements rather than just curl/wget commands in the terminal.

integrity.description: The data in the report matches the data seen on the website during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numbers and facility names in the final .txt file match the values visible in the browser screenshots for Harris County and St. James Parish.

integrity.description: The bookmarks were added through the browser interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the bookmarking dialog or the process of dragging URLs into the specific folder.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Harris County, TX typically has ~380 TRI facilities; St. James Parish, LA has ~11. Common chemicals include Benzene and Ethylene. The bookmark folder must be exactly 'Community Health Research'. The output file must be at /home/ga/Documents/tri_community_report.txt and the downloaded data file must be at least 10KB.
